subject: PO cutoff, preauth evidence & rolling invoice lane for NovaCare
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacare.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novacare.com, alex.brown@novacare.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO format, cutoff & evidence for early invoices

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement had two follow-ups so we can close the PO and get you on our rolling invoice lane:

1) PO formatting: our AP system requires PO number in header + PO line reference for each invoice line (we use the field "PO_LINE_ID"). Can you confirm Redwood will populate that field on every invoice record?

2) Invoice cadence: NovaCare prefers weekly consolidated invoices for usage-based services (cutoff: Monday 11:59pm ET). Is there any technical constraint preventing weekly aggregation?

3) Preauth / evidence: for early invoices (we sometimes request pre-billing to meet month-end), we need exportable evidence packaged as a CSV + a zip of sample request files (FE evidence) for our auditors. Can you provide a sample invoice CSV and a sample evidence bundle?

4) Net terms: standard is Net45; are there discount triggers tied to earlier payment? Also any recommended PO wording to include to avoid holdbacks?

Please loop in whoever owns billing and legal. If you can send the sample CSV and a filled PO template, procurement will route the PO next week.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager — NovaCare

Attachments: NovaCare_PO_Template.pdf
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacare.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format, cutoff & evidence for early invoices

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I attached the sample CSV and a short evidence bundle to show what NovaCare would receive:

- PO_LINE_ID: Yes — we can emit PO header + PO_LINE_ID on every invoice line. We'll also include a mapping column for GL/BU where needed.
- Weekly aggregation: supported. We can set the cutoff to Monday 23:59 ET and emit a consolidated invoice with line-level usage details. If you need timezone alignment to ET explicitly, we'll enforce it.
- Evidence bundle: attached a redwood-invoice-example.csv and a small sample FE evidence zip (fe-request-evidence.zip). The CSV contains token-level cost, model id, request id, and PO_LINE_ID for each record.
- Net Terms / discounts: Standard hosted customers default to Net45. We do offer a 1.5% early-payment credit if invoices are paid within Net15 for committed monthly minimums — happy to discuss in procurement if you want to bake that into the PO.

Action items I'm proposing:
- I fill the NovaCare_PO_Template.pdf with our vendor/company details and return it to procurement (attached).
- Vanessa (CC) will confirm the GL/BU mapping options we can support for your ERP.
- Ben will surface any billing SLO notes for weekly consolidation.

Posting attachments now. Let me know if you want a short screen share to walk the file shapes before you route the PO.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-invoice-example.csv, filled_NovaCare_PO_Template.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format, cutoff & evidence for early invoices (internal)

Team —

Quick internal note before we lock this down with NovaCare:

- GL mapping: we can provide a "GL_CODE" column in the CSV. For weekly invoices we can either: (A) produce one consolidated invoice with all GL_CODEs by line, or (B) produce separate invoices per GL (probably not desired). Let's recommend option A.
- Cutoff enforcement: we'll implement a hard cutoff at Monday 23:59 ET; any late events will appear on the following week's invoice. Confirming Ben that this won't change tokenization / KV caching billing windows.
- Evidence package: we can include request_id, model_id, prompt_hash, timestamp, and cost_center. For FE evidence zip, legal has asked that it be redacted for customer PII — Kimberly will confirm redaction script.

I'll draft suggested PO wording:
"Redwood Inference will deliver weekly consolidated invoices (cutoff Monday 23:59 ET). Each invoice line will include PO header and PO_LINE_ID. Invoice evidence (CSV + zipped FE artifacts) will be delivered on invoice issuance and will be redacted of any customer PII as required by law."

Ben — can you confirm if the early-payment credit needs a formal addendum or can live as language in the PO?

-Vanessa

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format, cutoff & evidence for early invoices (internal)

Vanessa / Dylan —

Confirming: weekly consolidated invoice (single invoice per week) is fine. From the runtime/billing side:

- We will bucket usage by invoice week using ET cutoff at 23:59. No change to KV cache accounting; billing will reference request-level IDs so NovaCare can tie tokens to requests.
- Early payment credit: requires a short commercial addendum (one-paragraph) that defines the committed monthly minimum and the early-payment window (Net15). I'll draft language and attach a small addendum to the PO once procurement confirms commit level.
- Attachments/Evidence: FE artifacts should be ZIP with folder names per request_id; we will run the redaction pipeline prior to zipping. Kimberly — please confirm timeline for redaction run (we need a 24h turnaround after invoice generation).

I'll prepare the addendum draft and a sample consolidated invoice layout for NovaCare.

-Ben

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@novacare.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novacare.com, alex.brown@novacare.com
Date: 2027-04-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO format, cutoff & evidence for early invoices

Dylan / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the samples. Procurement reviewed the CSV and the sample evidence bundle and it's in good shape. A few final asks before we issue the PO:

1) Please include the PO_LINE_ID both as a separate CSV column and as a visible invoice line item on the PDF invoice.
2) We accept your weekly consolidation model A (single invoice with GL column).
3) Early-payment credit: procurement wants the addendum language and a clear definition of "committed monthly minimum" before we accept the 1.5% Net15 credit. Please send draft addendum and an example calculation showing how the credit would apply for a blurred usage month.
4) Redaction SLA: 24h redaction turnaround is acceptable. Please confirm in writing.

If you can return the addendum and the filled PO with those items called out explicitly, we'll sign and route via DocuSign next business day.

Thanks — look forward to getting this live.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager — NovaCare

Attachments: none
